name: prism
why: prism-ml's Bonsai GGUFs are packed in PQ2_0 (ternary, FP16 scale per 128 weights, 1.71 bpw). Upstream's Q1_0/Q2_0 are the group-64 formats and cannot read a group-128 file. The qwen35 architecture itself is already upstream; only the weight format is not.
notes: claims verified against the merged tree, not copied from the fork's docs: ggml.h defines PQ2_0=142 / PTQ1_0=143, and `dspark` is the only arch string present here and absent from upstream b11065. dflash and dfly are drafter variants, not separate LLM_ARCH entries.

upstream had independently implemented two of the fork's optimizations by b11065 - the DGX-Spark L2 prefetch in ggml-cuda/mmvq.cu (now mmvq_should_prefetch / mmvq_prefetch_l2) and the HIP crumb-unpack in vecdotq.cuh. Both resolved toward upstream's version. Re-check this on every refresh; it is the cheapest way for the series to shrink.

this port is telecode's own merge of the fork onto b11065, NOT a regeneration of a vendor rebase. The fork's own base was still b10615 at the time. If `vendor_drift.py status` reports the vendor has rebased, regenerate from their base instead - it inherits their testing, which this merge does not.
